title: Scriptalias
description: Binds a Lua script to a component lifecycle event. Accepts a bare path string (shorthand) or a full descriptor object.

oneOf.title: PathShorthand
oneOf.description: Short form: just the script path. The loader infers event=onLoad and no args.

script.description: Relative or absolute path to the Lua script file.

event.description: Lifecycle event that triggers this script.

args.description: Arguments forwarded to the script as a key-value table. String values support {token} interpolation against the owning component's properties.

priority.description: Execution order when multiple scripts share the same event. Lower numbers run first.

enabled.description: Whether this script binding is active.

once.description: When true, the script executes exactly once and then de-registers itself.

timeout.description: Maximum seconds the script may run before the loader forcefully terminates it.
